simple.meaning: נְקוֹדָא (Nᵉqôwdâʼ) is a Hebrew word meaning “Nekoda , a Temple-servant.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: נְקוֹדָא (H5353) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Ezra 2:48, with occurrences in Ezra, Nehemiah.
